source: segmentation (internet footage, background replaced by pure white)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (pen, tin and keyboard centroids constant to <1 px std over all 34 frames; no background to track, it is pure white)
camera.view: overhead, roughly perpendicular to desk; no strong perspective (tin is nearly round: 133 x 125 px)
camera.duplicate_frames: frames 3, 9, 15, 21, 27, 33 are near-repeats of the previous frame (likely 25->30 fps conversion); frame-to-frame displacements are 0 there

right_hand.description: person's right hand + forearm, skin coloured, enters from bottom edge at x~900-1100, fingers on the keyboard's lower-right keys
right_hand.notes: forearm truncated by bottom image edge (y=673) in every frame; mask centroid (cx,cy) is of the visible part; hand_cx/hand_cy = centroid of mask within 200 px of topmost point (hand only); tip_x/tip_y = topmost fingertip
right_hand.extent_px: visible hand+forearm main-axis length 307-384 (grows as the hand reaches up), width across 108-131

left_hand.description: person's left hand + forearm entering from bottom-left (x~480-825), fingers pinched, resting left of the keyboard
left_hand.moves: essentially static (centroid std 0.7 px; slight finger fidget, <=4 px)
left_hand.extent_px: visible hand+forearm main-axis length ~459-464, width ~107; bbox x 478-825, y 326-673 (truncated by bottom edge)

keyboard.description: white/silver Apple-style wireless keyboard (no numpad), rotated, centre right of image
keyboard.visible_frames: 0-33 (lower-right part partly covered by right hand)
keyboard.track: tracks/keyboard.csv (raw mask, contaminated by hand occlusion - use footprint below)

footprint_px.long_axis_direction: from upper-left corner (~900,162) down-right to (~1190,372), ~36 deg below horizontal
footprint_px.method: per-frame minAreaRect of grey keyboard pixels away from skin, median over 34 frames (frame std <1 px); rect may include ~2-4 px of rounded corner slack

pen.description: pen/marker (clear-grey barrel, dark tip at lower-right end) lying diagonally at lower left

tin.description: round dark metal tin / desk organiser with paper clips and pins, top-right corner

events.event: right fingers resting on keyboard lower-right keys (tip ~1030,386)
right hand starts moving up-left across the keyboard (tip y 386->378; first clear motion; slight drift from frame 4-6)
fastest outward motion frames 9-12 (tip moves ~20-28 px/frame)
right hand reaches farthest up-left position (tip ~930,292); stays roughly there through frame 19 (min hand_cx at frame 18)
right hand starts moving back down-right (direction reversal between frames 19 and 20)
right hand back near starting position (tip ~1038,388); stationary to end
